name: Webscanner
description: A webscanner plugin that performs automated client-side web security assessments. Point it at any domain and it produces a structured Markdown pentest report covering secrets exposure, vulnerable JS libraries, security misconfigurations, XSS sinks, CORS issues, and more with zero manual setup required.
longDescription:
Ships **1 skill**, `scan` (Client-side web security scanner — runs automatically with no setup required).

Installs with `claude plugin install webscanner@claude-community` from `enderphan94/web_scan`.

A Claude Code plugin that performs automated client-side web security assessments. Point it at any domain and it produces a structured Markdown pentest report covering secrets exposure, vulnerable JS libraries, security misconfigurations, XSS sinks, CORS issues, and more — with zero manual setup required.
